messages:
anya: heads-up — PR #49988 is ready for review. It updates allocator accounting and shortens the prefetch window. expected impact: small p99 mem bump for long sequences (~4-8%). need runtime + security eyes and a canary slot.

sam: can you paste the high-level risk list? does it touch kernel selection paths or just allocator layers?

anya: touches allocator + a tiny runtime kernel-selection override. not a kernel rewrite, just adds a fallback preference when batch size > 8.

lee: ok. need to know if this changes eviction ordering — if so, evictions could spike under mem pressure. can you call out the eviction test results?

anya: eviction ordering unchanged. added unit + integration test in allocator_test and a perf run (attached). perf run: 30m synthetic long-seq, p95 stable, p99 +6%.

maria: infra question — will this affect dedicated pools (reserved capacity)? If yes we need to surface to account team for capacity checks.

anya: it should be safe for Dedicated in canary config, but recommend canary in Hosted first to observe real traffic.

infra-bot: CI pipeline passed — lint, unit, integ, e2e: all green. canary job queued.

ryan: SLO question — if p99 shifts we might need a temporary SLO exemption or alert tuning. what metric do you want us to watch?

anya: watch node_memory_p99, allocator_evictions/sec, and request_latency_p99. I'll add a short dashboard and an alert runbook.

security-team: quick security ask — does this change any KMS/HSM calls or expose new logs with PII?

anya: no KMS changes. logs: added a debug line in allocator that strips any model prompt content. nothing PII.

lee: I can take runtime review and own the canary if scheduled before 11am PT tomorrow. I want a short canary plan: sample traffic, duration, pass criteria, rollback plan.

anya: plan: Hosted canary on canary-1 for 2 hours with 5% traffic (sampled). pass if node_memory_p99 increase <10% and evictions don't increase >20%. rollback: revert route and scale down canary, then roll back PR.

sam: pinging platform for merge slot — @maria can you help schedule the canary window and cc SRE?

maria: can do. tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT works. I'll reserve the slot and notify SRE. who will own rollback?

lee: I'll own rollback and be on call for the window.

anya: thanks. can runtime + security reply with a short +1 or concerns? adding checklist in PR description now.

sam: small nit in PR diff (naming) but non-blocking. +1 assuming runtime signoff.

security-team: reviewed logs + KMS statement. no blockers from sec, please ensure the debug log stays non-sensitive. +1.

lee: reviewed runtime changes, ran local smoke with batch=16. LGTM apart from one comment about a nil check (pushed a small fix). +1 for canary slot.

maria: slot reserved. tagging SRE and platform on the canary doc. :thumbsup:

anya: awesome — assigning canary owners in PR and will follow up with the dashboard link. thanks all. :pray:
